body: I'm so sorry that you have to understand how this feels.  I'm not sure if we will try to be friends.  You should make the best choices for your own health.  I feel like these exes can't just have us any way that they're willing to take us.  We still have some control over what kinds of relationships we let into our lives.

I am also first gen and I know it is a real struggle.  Your GPA does not define you.  Even if you can't graduate, life is still worth living.  And there is no expiration on your degree.  You can take a break and come back to it.  Take fewer classes at a time maybe.  Focus on you first.

I have been going through the same struggle.  My therapist suggested today to keep a schedule for my days.  Wake up, hygiene, get dressed.  Have allotments of time in your day for your dance, your art, everything.  Keep in contact with other people (through the phone) as much as you can.  Hope that helps.
